blocks.title: Operating Highlights - Income Statement
blocks.footnote: FYE 12/31/24 Other Income includes $85,000 of non-recurring income (DSCR excluding it: 1.16x). It is included in EBITDA because it was a real receipt of cash to the company.

blocks.text: Revenues increased 7.0%, from $920,000 in FYE 12/31/23 to $984,400 during FYE 12/31/24. Sales then increased 5.0%, from $984,400 in FYE 12/31/24 to $1.034M during FYE 12/31/25.
The margins for net income and EBITDA have varied (net income between 3% to 15% of sales, while EBITDA has maintained a margin of between 6% to 18% of sales).

During FYE 12/31/24 the company recognized $85,000 of non-recurring income. As it provided cash to the company, it is not removed from the cash flows when calculating EBITDA. Excluding it, DSCR for FYE 12/31/24 would be 1.16x.

Cash flows were not sufficient to service the obligations of the Borrower in every period. DSCR was 0.71x, 2.23x and 1.42x during FYE 12/31/23, 12/31/24 and 12/31/25, respectively. Shareholder salaries for the same periods were $70,000, $72,000 and $75,000, respectively.

Net worth increased each year from the retention of earnings. Total liabilities have changed materially over the periods reviewed and leverage (debt to worth) is improving (1.36x to 0.31x). Please see Exhibit D - Historical Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth for further detail.

Historical operations have not generated enough cash flow to cover the proposed debt service in every year. For DSCR to reach 1.00x, sales could decline 9.9% and 3.2% in FYE 12/31/24 and FYE 12/31/25, respectively; sales would need to increase 2.5% in FYE 12/31/23. Our model adjusts the cost of goods sold so that gross profit margins are consistent with historical levels. Operating expenses are treated as a fixed cost and are not adjusted to sales.
